description: Read a tournament's full bracket exactly as stored: every round and match with match_id, both players, winner, score, structured score_sets, status (pending / ready / completed) and the next-match pointer. Use it to refresh full match state before reporting or undoing a result — and pair it with report_result's expect_winner / expect_score so a stale read cannot overwrite another referee's correction. Only brackets created through this MCP server (generate_bracket) are stored match-by-match; for web-console events the pages derive the draw from the roster, so this returns bracket: null with a note. Read-only, no credentials needed.
name: get_bracket
